question: Can an adaptive hybrid improve independently verified success or common-success search cost over the strongest Phase 4 expanded/P3 baseline?

training.model_selection: Whole-family validation pairwise logistic loss for relevance; squared log-cost on independently verified mode completions for selector. Select once before evaluation, then refit development. Include linear and applicability-only controls regardless of winner.
training.labels: Verified alternatives over actual rejected applications; strictly lower attempts among two independently verified continuations. Unknown/censored never mathematical negatives. Selector fits log attempt cost only among verified equal-budget mode searches; it predicts conditional cost, not probability of provability. All censored modes retained and missingness reported.

selection.baseline_lane: 20 slots; 16 on existential goals; structural and strong symbolic normalizers first, original Phase 4 order within class
selection.novelty_lane: 4 normally, 8 existential; exclude unresolved-data generic rules; exact eligibility/candidate rows retained
selection.order: Explicit P3 scores followed by tactic-string tie rule in all new arms. Historical baselines retain original stable ties. phase4_canonical separately measures tie intervention.
selection.staged: First two non-existential expansions use symbolic set, then deterministic structure policy; root existential immediately retrieves. One shared global budget, no restarted search or free fallback.
selection.naive: Baseline then typed union truncated to same cap, explicitly no protection/optimization; saturation can leave no novelty.

automation: simp_all remains visible general symbolic action; ring/omega specialized actions; group simp-only visible structure-gated action. Aesop/grind separate one-call external references, 2 seconds/call under same outer wall, internal work not equated to primitive steps.

uncertainty.unit: paired theorem averages over repeats; theorem bootstrap and separate equal-family sensitivity; common-verified effort and all-run resource use separated; secondary contrasts descriptive

freezing: Statements, families, protocol, budgets and selection rules fixed before model selection. Model and exact execution source hashed and committed before first final-test run. No final-test retuning.
historical: All Phase 1–5 held-out results used for diagnosis only; never training labels or fresh evaluation.
